name: Oxprenolol
summary: Oxprenolol, sold under the brand name Trasicor among others, is a non-selective beta blocker with some intrinsic sympathomimetic activity. It was used for the treatment of angina pectoris, abnormal heart rhythms, and high blood pressure.

combinations.note: Listed as a significant drug interaction on Wikidata.

pharmacology.text: Oxprenolol is a beta blocker. In addition, it has been found to act as an antagonist of the serotonin 5-HT1A and 5-HT1B receptors with respective Ki values of 94.2 nM and 642 nM in rat brain tissue.

uses.text: Oxprenolol has been used in the treatment of angina pectoris, abnormal heart rhythms, and high blood pressure. It has been used to treat anxiety as well.

sideEffects.en: It can cause tiredness, cold hands and feet, a slow heart rate, dizziness and vivid dreams. Stopping a beta blocker suddenly can make heart symptoms worse, and in people with asthma it can tighten the airways.
sideEffects.zh: 它可能造成疲倦、手腳冰冷、心跳過慢、頭暈與做夢鮮明。突然停用乙型阻斷劑可能使心臟症狀惡化，氣喘患者使用則可能造成呼吸道收縮。
sideEffects.zhHans: 它可能造成疲倦、手脚冰冷、心跳过慢、头晕与做梦鲜明。突然停用乙型阻断剂可能使心脏症状恶化，气喘患者使用则可能造成呼吸道收缩。

fact.en: It is a beta blocker with partial agonist activity, meaning it gives the receptor a small nudge while blocking the much larger signal from adrenaline.
fact.zh: 它是具部分促效活性的乙型阻斷劑，也就是在阻斷腎上腺素強烈訊號的同時，自己仍對受體給予輕微的刺激。
fact.zhHans: 它是具部分促效活性的乙型阻断剂，也就是在阻断肾上腺素强烈信号的同时，自己仍对受体给予轻微的刺激。
